theorems.name: Submission.dtc_bc_bh_blowUp_massOn_ball_bounded
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (x : Euclid P) (θ : ℝ), IsOpen U → 0 < n → HasMassDensity T x θ → ∀ (lams : ℕ → ℝ) (hlams : ∀ j, 0 < lams j), Tendsto lams atTop (𝓝 0) → ∀ R : ℝ, ∃ c : ℝ≥0∞, c ≠ ∞ ∧ ∀ᶠ j in atTop, (blowUp T x (lams j) (hlams j).ne').massOn (ball 0 R) ≤ c
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
